Full citation: Hu Q, Wu X, Jiang Y, Liu Y, Liang Y, Liu X, Yin H, Baba N. (2013). Differential gene expression and bioinformatics analysis of copper resistance gene afe_1073 in Acidithiobacillus ferrooxidans.
Strain: Experiment: A. ferrooxidans DY26 and DC. ATCC 23270 is the reference annotation/premise; not an experimental strain.
Experimental type: qRT-PCR under copper stress; sequence comparison; computational annotation
Directly measured/reported facts: PubMed/publisher abstract checked: qRT-PCR showed afe_1073 transcript rose with copper in DY26 and DC; DY26 showed lower expression than DC at matched copper despite greater copper resistance. Evidence limitation: No ATCC 23270 or DSM 14882 experiment; no purified transporter, Cu+ flux, ATPase activity, or direct export assay reported in the accessible abstract. Full article not accessible here.
Evidence class: Original abstract verified; other-strain transcript/sequence evidence, not same-strain validation
